note: VARIETY: Taiwanese Sixian Hakka (四縣腔). SCRIPT: Han characters using Taiwan MoE 客家語推薦用字 as primary; Pha̍k-fa-sṳ (POJ) romanization is the accepted alternative but keep ONE system consistent (Han primary). REGISTER: informal 你, everyday spoken Hakka. Use genuine Hakka forms, NOT Mandarin read in Hakka: 𠊎 (I, ngài), 毋 (not, m̀), 係 (to be), 佢 (he/she), 這下/今晡日 (now/today), 講 (speak), 承蒙 (thanks). Avoid Mandarin loans where Hakka has its own word. ⚠️ DIRECTIONAL DRAFT: these examples set variety+script+register direction (authored by a non-native, moderate-confidence source) — the Opus translator should follow the SPEC and produce natural Sixian Hakka, and the whole pass MUST be verified by a native Hakka speaker before it ships.
